legend: You are given an n×m%%ZSMJ0%% table, consisting of characters «A», «G», «C», «T». Let's call a table nice, if every 2×2%%ZSMJ1%% square contains all four distinct characters. Your task is to find a nice table (also consisting of «A», «G», «C», «T»), that differs from the given table in the minimum number of characters.
input: First line contains two positive integers n%%ZSMJ2%% and m%%ZSMJ3%% — number of rows and columns in the table you are given (2≤n,m,n×m≤300000%%ZSMJ4%%). Then, n%%ZSMJ5%% lines describing the table follow. Each line contains exactly m%%ZSMJ6%% characters «A», «G», «C», «T».
output: Output n%%ZSMJ7%% lines, m%%ZSMJ8%% characters each. This table must be nice and differ from the input table in the minimum number of characters.
note: In the first sample, the table is already nice. In the second sample, you can change 9 elements to make the table nice.
